notes: Sale and Purchase are now separate screens, and the side menu has Quick add for a sale, a purchase, an item, a customer or a supplier. A purchase line starts empty, shows the last lot for reference and takes an expiry date. A chosen supplier can be removed, and a name two suppliers share is asked about instead of blocking the bill. The item form is three boxes and offers the stock once saved. On a tablet held sideways the side menu stays beside the screen.
